coveredBehaviours: the batch is bound to the verified candidate, product source and migration set
a successful current-period import has a non-zero denominator and complete decode/reconciliation/write accounting
an identical reimport uses the same source artifact and produces zero writes and an unchanged logical-state hash
malformed and stale sources stop before a transaction with stable diagnostics and no state change
an injected database failure attempts a write, commits none, rolls back once and restores the exact logical state
duplicate FIDE identifiers are rejected by the acceptance verdict without exporting individual identifiers
missing scenarios and candidate-identity drift are infrastructure errors
GO does not claim that the verifier downloaded a list or executed the ChessPairings import route
